raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Fix MRV2 `draft_model` adaptive profiling startup when PIECEWISE padding expands draft input beyond its compiled range. Initially discovered during Gemma3 Prefix-LM validation for [#60040](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60040), then independently reproduced on upstream with **Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B (target) + Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B (draft)** on **TRITON_ATTN and ROCM_ATTN**, confirming a shared MRV2 dummy-path bug independent of #60040's Prefix-LM changes.

## Claims

- Preserve valid dummy query counts across PIECEWISE input padding, retaining room for draft correction tokens.
- Keep trailing tokens marked as padding and write context positions only for valid queries; preserve FULL dummy query reshaping.
- Cover padding/context behavior and PIECEWISE dispatch with two focused tests, including a FULL varlen control.

## Validation

Actual **`vllm serve`** runs and HTTP requests on a single gfx1151 Radeon 8060S, BF16, AITER disabled, `VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error`. All patched runs show nonzero draft acceptance and FULL/PIECEWISE execution in native metrics/logs. No worker monkeypatches or profiling skips.

### Qwen3: independent upstream validation

**Target: `Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B`; draft: `Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B`.** 

| Backend | Before | After | GSM8K, 128 questions |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| **TRITON_ATTN** | Startup fails: `1032` outside `[1,1024]` | 16/16 smoke requests completed | **83/128 (64.84%)**, 0 invalid |
| ROCM_ATTN | Same startup assertion | 16/16 smoke requests completed | **82/128 (64.06%)**, 1 invalid |

Smoke requests include eight ordinary prompts and eight boundary prompts of 65–1800 tokens. GSM8K uses five shots, greedy, 256 output tokens, seed 0 and concurrency 8. Draft/accepted token counts: Triton **13,923/11,047** (smoke + GSM8K), ROCm **14,466/10,958** (smoke + GSM8K). Both backends completed all 128 evaluation requests successfully; the ROCm invalid answer could not be parsed as a numerical answer.

<details>
<summary>Qwen3 serve and GSM8K commands</summary>

```bash
export VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=0
export VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error

.venv/bin/vllm serve ~/models/Qwen3-1.7B \
  --served-model-name adaptive-validation --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8017 \
  --dtype bfloat16 --attention-backend TRITON_ATTN --seed 0 \
  --max-model-len 2048 --max-num-seqs 8 --max-num-batched-tokens 1024 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.3 --kv-cache-memory-bytes 2147483648 \
  --enable-prefix-caching --cudagraph-metrics \
  --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE","cudagraph_capture_sizes":[1,2,4,8,12,16,32,512,1024]}' \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"draft_model","model":"/home/tang/models/Qwen3-0.6B","num_speculative_tokens":3,"enable_adaptive_verification":true}'
```

```bash
.venv/bin/python tests/evals/gsm8k/gsm8k_eval.py \
  --host http://127.0.0.1 --port 8017 \
  --num-questions 128 --num-shots 5 --max-tokens 256 \
  --temperature 0 --seed 0 --max-concurrency 8 \
  --save-results /tmp/gsm8k-adaptive-triton.json
```

For ROCm, replace `TRITON_ATTN` with `ROCM_ATTN` in the serve command and repeat both the smoke requests and GSM8K evaluation, changing `--save-results` to `/tmp/gsm8k-adaptive-rocm.json`.

</details>

### Gemma3: integration validation with #60040

The bug was initially discovered during Gemma3 validation for [#60040](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60040). The Qwen3 reproduction above confirms it also occurs independently of that PR's Prefix-LM changes.

**Target: `google/gemma-3-4b-it`; draft: `google/gemma-3-270m-it`.** The text-only draft uses a local validation copy, `gemma-3-270m-it-vocab262208`, with **64 zero embedding rows appended** to match the target vocabulary size of 262208; existing tokenizer IDs are preserved. Baseline: #60040 head `309e622d88`; after: that head plus this fix.

| Backend | Before | After | AI2D, 128 diagrams |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| **TRITON_ATTN** | Startup fails: `1032` outside `[1,1024]` | 8/8 smoke requests completed | **88/128 (68.75%)**, 0 invalid |
| ROCM_ATTN | Same startup assertion | 8/8 smoke requests completed | **87/128 (67.97%)**, 1 invalid |

Smoke covers single-image, two-image and text requests; all six color/shape/arithmetic checks pass on both backends. AI2D uses 128 unique diagrams shuffled with seed 20261005, greedy, 8 output tokens and batches of eight concurrent requests; invalid answer formats count as incorrect. Response text matches on **127/128** samples. Draft/accepted counts (smoke + AI2D): Triton **570/140**, ROCm **579/146**.

<details>
<summary>Gemma3 serve command</summary>

Run from a checkout containing #60040 plus this fix, retaining the environment variables in the Qwen3 commands:

```bash
.venv/bin/vllm serve ~/models/gemma-3-4b-it \
  --served-model-name adaptive-validation --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8017 \
  --dtype bfloat16 --attention-backend TRITON_ATTN --seed 0 \
  --max-model-len 2048 --max-num-seqs 8 --max-num-batched-tokens 1024 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.3 --kv-cache-memory-bytes 2147483648 \
  --limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image":2}' --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --cudagraph-metrics \
  --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE","cudagraph_capture_sizes":[1,2,4,8,12,16,32,512,1024]}' \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"draft_model","model":"/home/tang/models/gemma-3-270m-it-vocab262208","num_speculative_tokens":3,"enable_adaptive_verification":true}'
```

Repeat with `ROCM_ATTN`. AI2D requests use `/v1/chat/completions` with `image_url` content and instruct the model to return only the option letter.

</details>

These runs validate startup and serving; they do not establish general adaptive accuracy parity or performance improvements.

<details>
<summary>Regression and style commands</summary>

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -o addopts= \
  tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_input_batch_v2.py \
  tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_model_runner_v2.py \
  tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_model_runner_v2_cudagraph_profiling.py \
  tests/v1/spec_decode/test_adaptive_verification.py -q
# 50 passed, 3 skipped

.venv/bin/python -m pytest -o addopts= \
  tests/v1/cudagraph/test_cudagraph_dispatch.py \
  tests/v1/cudagraph/test_cudagraph_manager.py \
  tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_pcp_manager.py \
  tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_ubatch_slicing.py \
  tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_input_batch_v2.py::test_dummy_context_preserves_token_padding \
  tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_model_runner_v2.py::test_dummy_dispatch_preserves_piecewise_token_budget -q
# 150 passed, 5 skipped; 3 existing Ray-dependent cases failed before Ray was installed

uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python 'ray==2.56.1'
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -o addopts= \
  tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_pcp_manager.py::test_parallel_config_manages_decode_sharding -q
# 3 passed
```

Restoring the original `execute_model` and `set_dummy_context` functions makes the two regression cases fail; the FULL control still passes. Existing worker CI covers these files on H200 and MI355. NVIDIA and multi-GPU execution were not tested locally.

</details>

## Details

`_dummy_run` reserves eight correction slots (1024 → 1016), but PIECEWISE dispatch pads to 1024 and dummy preparation counts that padding as valid queries. Draft expansion then produces 1032 tokens. Passing valid and padded counts separately through `InputBatch.make_dummy` restores the distinction already used for real requests.

This fixes the additional startup bug discovered while testing #60040; #60040's Prefix-LM changes are used only for Gemma3 integration validation and are not included in this patch. Qwen3 + Triton reproduces the problem without Prefix-LM.

Duplicate check (2026-10-05): no direct duplicate found. #54065/#54077 adjust profiling splits, #56182 separates profiling passes, #58984 handles DP request padding, and #55990 refactors standalone drafting

AI assistance was used for implementation, review, and validation.

---

<summary>Pull Request Checklist</summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.
- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.

</details>
